categories.main_business_segments: Black Sesame International Holding Limited operates primarily in the design and provision of automotive-grade intelligent vehicle computing SoCs (System-on-Chip) and SoC-based intelligent vehicle solutions. Its main business lines include Advanced Driving Assistance System (ADAS) chips and solutions, smart cockpit integration, advanced imaging, and vehicle interconnection technologies. The company also offers intelligent imaging solutions and is expanding into robotics and vehicle-road-cloud integration applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies are centered on proprietary automotive-grade SoCs, self-developed IP cores, advanced neural processing units (NPUs), and image signal processors (ISPs). Key production methods include chip design, algorithm development, and software-driven SoC solutions, with manufacturing outsourced to third parties. Notable innovations include the AMCAX NPU architecture, BaRT AI toolchain, and BLink dual-chip interconnect technology, supporting large AI models and high-performance edge inference.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are leading automotive OEMs (such as BYD, Geely, Dongfeng, and FAW Group), Tier 1 automotive suppliers, and robotics companies. The company’s solutions are widely adopted in new energy vehicles, traditional fuel vehicles, commercial vehicles, and are expanding into robotics and intelligent transportation sectors. End markets include automotive manufacturers, commercial vehicle operators, and emerging robotics enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations and revenue are concentrated in Mainland China, with headquarters and principal business locations in Wuhan, Shenzhen, Beijing, and Chengdu. It is actively pursuing global expansion, targeting overseas markets such as the United States and Europe through collaborations with international automakers and Tier 1 suppliers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Black Sesame operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on upstream and midstream activities such as chip design, R&D, and solution development, while outsourcing manufacturing and assembly to third-party foundries. It supplies chips and integrated solutions to downstream automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and robotics companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing intelligent driving technologies, expanding mass production of its chip platforms (A1000, C1200, A2000), and deepening R&D in core IPs such as NPUs and ISPs. Key R&D directions include AI model support (especially Transformer and BEV models), cross-domain chip integration, cost optimization, and expanding application scenarios to robotics and edge AI. The company emphasizes building an open ecosystem, global market expansion, and continuous innovation in chip architecture and software toolchains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of automotive-grade chips, SoC-based intelligent vehicle solutions, and licensing of self-developed software and algorithms. The company recognizes revenue at the point of sale for products and solutions, with a growing share from software and algorithm licensing, especially in intelligent imaging solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Black Sesame positions itself as a leading domestic provider of intelligent driving chips in China, competing with both domestic and international semiconductor companies specializing in automotive AI chips. It ranks third in the domestic market for integrated highway NoA solutions among single-supplier chip providers and differentiates itself through mass production experience, proprietary IP, and advanced AI capabilities. The competitive landscape is consolidating, with only a few technology leaders expected to dominate.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB474.3 million, up 51.8% year-on-year, with a gross profit margin of 41.1%. It achieved a net profit of RMB313.3 million (mainly due to fair value changes in financial instruments), though it still recorded an adjusted net loss of RMB1.3 billion. The company has demonstrated rapid revenue growth, significant R&D investment, and improved gross margins, with a medium-term goal of achieving operating profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Black Sesame emphasizes its ability to deliver high-performance, cost-effective, and customizable intelligent driving solutions through proprietary chip architectures and full-stack software-hardware integration. Its unique value lies in self-developed IPs, support for large AI models, rapid mass production capabilities, and an open ecosystem approach that empowers OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to create differentiated products. The company’s solutions are validated by leading automakers and are positioned as robust, scalable platforms for intelligent mobility and robotics.
